description: Language-agnostic corpus of the type renderers: each case lists a schema export and the GraphQL type, protobuf message and TypeScript type every implementation must render for it (null: the format has no form and the export is refused). A nested object becomes a named declaration <Parent><Field>; a form the target cannot express (a union, a map, a tuple, any value, an array of arrays) is the GraphQL scalar JSON or the protobuf field bytes (the JSON text of the value); a field name that is no identifier is made one; a name in `taken` is never claimed.

cases.name: nested objects and arrays of objects get named declarations
a nested name that is taken falls back to JSON text
string enums, numeric enums and constants are scalars
cases.graphql:
type Row {
  mode: String!
  depth: Int!
  kind: String!
  ratio: Float!
  flag: Boolean
}

cases.name: maps are protobuf maps and GraphQL JSON
unions, tuples and any value carry their JSON
cases.graphql:
scalar JSON

type Row {
  choice: JSON!
  pair: JSON!
  anything: JSON
  merged: JSON
}

cases.name: arrays of arrays, nullable arrays and arrays of nullable items carry their JSON in protobuf
field names that are no identifiers are made one
two fields that make the same identifier refuse the export
a top-level union of objects
cases.typescript: export type Row = { readonly a: string } | { readonly b: number };

cases.name: type lists and null
